title: training-effort-observation-request/1
description: The request body of the machine route POST /api/training/effort-source/observe, sent by Command Center through the EDC-proxied machine path with an atk_ key of scope training:due-source:read in x-api-key. The training service answers TrainingEffortServiceObservationV1@1.0.0, whose data member is TrainingEffortSourceV1@1.0.0 (training-effort-source-v1.schema.json). scope is a root study only. expectedAuthorityHash, when sent, pins the EDC service authority the caller observed before (the authorityHash of a previous answer); a changed authority is refused. The route answers 503 TRAINING_EFFORT_DISABLED unless the training service runs with TRAINING_EFFORT_LEDGER_ENABLED=true.
